name: html_code_block
title: Format character vector for display as code in HTML

origin.description: Wrap lines the way knitr wraps chunk output in PRE and CODE tags.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: Character vector. It is not coerced.

arguments.name: class
arguments.text: CSS classes applied to the PRE tag. Joined with spaces.

origin.details: Lines are collapsed with newlines inside the CODE element.

translation.description: Wrap lines the way knitr wraps chunk output in PRE and CODE tags.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: A string or a list of strings.

arguments.name: class_
arguments.text: CSS classes applied to the PRE tag. The trailing underscore avoids the Python keyword class.

translation.details: Lines are collapsed with newlines inside the CODE element.
translation.example:
from fansi import html_code_block
print(html_code_block(["hello world"], class_="pretty"))
